description: Look up published Solana syscall compute-unit costs, runtime limits, sysvar program IDs, native account sizes, or calculate rent exemption and a sum of published syscall CU constants. Free, no payment, no RPC. Pass topic=syscall|limit|sysvar|account|precompile|rent|cu. For rent pass size (bytes). For cu pass syscalls: [{ name, count, bytes?, inputs? }]. SHA-256 uses 85 + 1*bytes; Poseidon uses 61*n^2+542. This is not a full VM estimate.

name.description: Registered syscall name, slug, or other item name

size.description: Account data size in bytes, for topic=rent

slug.description: Item slug, if you already know it

syscalls.description: For topic=cu: list of { name, count, bytes?, inputs? }

topic.description: syscall, limit, sysvar, account, precompile, rent, or cu

name: lookup_solana_runtime
title: Solana runtime costs and limits (free)
